name: 心声风云四升级版
english_name: Voice of the Heart: Wind and Cloud IV, Upgraded Edition
english_description: Wind and Cloud IV ("Fengyun," by Sumxin), a MUD set in the world of Gu Long's wuxia novels, originally hosted at sumxin.com/bbs and fy.sumxin.com. It is a true source sibling of this archive's "Fengyun IV Decrypted Edition" (fysjmb) — several core files are byte-for-byte identical — a relationship not previously documented, though it happens to share a similar bug pattern with the unrelated codebase behind this collection's "wqfy."
